description: How a room's coverage segments change when a span [from, to] (unix seconds) is known to be received completely. Segments are kept sorted by lo; spans that overlap or touch an existing segment merge into it. resume is the highest hi, or null. Shared by desktop (message_store/coverage.rs) and mobile (message_store/coverage.dart).

cases.name: live tick extends the open segment
repair from before hi joins across the gap
a span after a gap stays separate
a span bridging two segments merges all three
a span inside a segment changes nothing
a span before every segment is kept first
